sceneContext: A seated, human-scale acoustic drum kit positioned in front of the player. The selected mobile-ready model contains a complete kit with stands, cymbals, pedals, and throne. Its measured raw bounds already have realistic proportions; a uniform 1.40 scale makes the cymbal height suitable for seated play while keeping the nearest playable parts inside natural arm-plus-stick reach. The refined asset changes PBR materials only and preserves the measured source geometry.
